documentation_excerpts.text: CoIR (Code Information Retrieval) benchmark, is designed to evaluate code retrieval capabilities. CoIR includes 10 curated code datasets, covering 8 retrieval tasks across 7 domains. […] It also provides a common and easy Python framework, installable via pip, and shares the same data schema as benchmarks like MTEB and BEIR for easy cross-benchmark evaluations.
For models and datasets, checkout out Hugging Face (HF) page: https://huggingface.co/CoIR-Retrieval.
